summary: Iteration 152 (zone-scoped App Settings + Taxi Hall competition gate): backend = 7/7 pytest passed (incl. cleanup), UI verified for AdminAppSettings (tab, zone bar, ZoneScopePicker selecting MQ, new Taxi Hall group fields, save+persist for the MQ override). Eligibility API + 403 gate on POST /api/rides/taxi-hall confirmed end-to-end with global threshold=101. One minor UX gap detected in the admin UI: ZoneScopePicker stores the country CODE in zone.country, so the zone label and save toast read 'Zone : MQ' / 'Paramètres enregistrés pour MQ' instead of 'Martinique' (spec wording mismatch — not a functional defect).

ui_bugs.issue: Zone label and save toast display the country CODE ('MQ') instead of the country NAME ('Martinique'). Spec expected: 'Paramètres enregistrés pour Martinique' and 'Zone : Martinique'. Cause: ZoneScopePicker sets zone.country to the option value (ISO code) and AdminAppSettings.js renders [zone.city, zone.state, zone.country].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') / interpolates ${zone.country} directly.

action_items: Map country code -> country name when rendering app-settings-zone-label and the success toast (e.g. lookup against the country list provided by ZoneScopePicker, or have the picker emit {code,name} so AdminAppSettings can display the human name). Backend is unaffected — only the UI string.
critical_code_review_comments: config.py get_app_settings_config(): most-specific zone resolution (city > state > country) implemented cleanly. _APP_SETTINGS_INT correctly excludes bools.
PUT /admin/app-settings sanitizes payload against DEFAULT_APP_SETTINGS keys (good — prevents arbitrary fields).
Cleanup-friendly: zone overrides are tagged with non-empty zone_key, making bulk cleanup straightforward.
Frontend AdminAppSettings.js handleSave: toast uses raw zone.country (ISO). Consider resolving the country name for human-readable feedback (minor UX).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all critical flows OK, 1 cosmetic label mismatch)

Country picker stores ISO code (e.g. 'MQ') — frontend label shows 'Zone : MQ'; backend resolves correctly. To re-test the driver Taxi Hall UI gate, login as jean.dupont@demo.sb, force global taxi_hall_require_competition=true with taxi_hall_min_acceptance_rate=101 via admin PUT, navigate to /chauffeur/home, open driver-fab-toggle, click the Taxi Hail action — the modal must NOT open and an error toast should show; then restore the global setting.
rca of the issue: UI cosmetic mismatch (toast/label showing 'MQ' instead of 'Martinique'): ZoneScopePicker emits {country: ISO_CODE, state, city} and AdminAppSettings.js interpolates that value directly. Backend (config.py) intentionally normalises country.upper() and uses it as part of zone_key — that contract is correct. Fix should live in the FRONTEND only: either (a) ZoneScopePicker emits a parallel country_name, or (b) AdminAppSettings keeps a code->name map and resolves it when composing the label/toast. No backend change required.
